meta.title: Per-IP limit stops trying many usernames
steps: Send 30 log-in attempts for 30 different unknown usernames within a few seconds
Wait the retryAfterSec the API reports (≤ 15 min IP window) for the window to clear
expected: Early attempts return 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS — API response
Later attempts are refused with 429 RATE_LIMITED or 423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED before all 30 are tried — API response
After retryAfterSec an attempt returns 401 again (limit is a window, not permanent) — API response

done: API up; QA IP window clean (run this case LAST: it limits this IP for up to 15 min)
2. Wait for the window to clear

2.observed: 11 of 30 refused; first refusal at index 19
